x-e-e2-05.topic: Alamu game da lokaci, wuri, da mutane.
x-e-e2-05.title: Ina ake cewa ‘Two tickets, please.’? Yanke hukunci ko bayanin ya wadatar.
x-e-e2-05.goal: Yanke hukunci ko za ka iya gano wurin daga jimlolin biyu da ka ji kawai, sannan ka zaɓi ƙarin alama da zai bambanta wuraren.
x-e-e2-05.material:
Ka ji abin da wani mutum da ma’aikacin tikiti suka faɗa. Ba su faɗi wurin ba.

Mutum: Two tickets, please.
Ma’aikaci: Here you are. Nunin yana farawa da 7:00.
x-e-e2-05.thinking.1: Kwatanta wurare da dama da za su yiwu.
x-e-e2-05.thinking.2: Zaɓi alamar da za ta bambanta wuraren da za a iya zaɓa.
x-e-e2-05.prereq.0: Kalmomi masu sauƙi kamar ticket, show, movie, popcorn.
x-e-e2-05.s.s1.prompt: Za ka iya yanke hukunci kan wuri guda daga waɗannan layuka biyu kawai?
x-e-e2-05.s.s1.hint.0: Ka yi tunani game da wurare biyu ko uku da za a iya faɗin waɗannan layuka a cikinsu.
x-e-e2-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunani ko wurin da kowane zaɓi ya ambata ya dace da layukan biyun.
x-e-e2-05.s.s1.o.a: Ba za mu iya yanke hukunci ba. Wurare da dama na yiwuwa, kamar gidan sinima ko ɗakin kade-kade.
x-e-e2-05.s.s1.r.a: Ana iya amfani da “show” da tikiti a wurare da dama.
x-e-e2-05.s.s1.o.b: Gidan sinima ne. Domin an ambaci tikiti.
x-e-e2-05.s.s1.r.b: Ana samun tikiti a wuraren da ba gidan sinima ba ma, kamar ɗakin kade-kade, gidan namun daji, ko tashar jirgin ƙasa.
x-e-e2-05.s.s1.o.c: Tashar jirgin ƙasa ce. Domin jirgin yana tashi da 7:00.
x-e-e2-05.s.s1.r.c: Ana kiran jirgin ƙasa “train” ne yawanci, ba “show” ba. Shaidar ba ta da ƙarfi.
x-e-e2-05.s.s1.explain: Kalmomin ticket da show ana amfani da su a wurare da dama, kamar gidan sinima ko ɗakin kade-kade. Yana da wuya a tabbatar da wuri guda daga layuka biyu kawai.
x-e-e2-05.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi duk ƙarin layukan da za su bambanta ko wurin “gidan sinima” ne ko “ɗakin kade-kade”.
x-e-e2-05.s.s2.hint.0: Saka kowane layi cikin yanayin gidan sinima da ɗakin kade-kade, sannan ka soke layin da ya dace da wuraren biyun.
x-e-e2-05.s.s2.hint.1: Bincika ko layukan da suka rage sun fi dacewa da wuri guda kawai.
x-e-e2-05.s.s2.r.a: Popcorn abinci ne da ake yawan saya a gidan sinima. Zai iya zama alamar da ta bambanta shi da ɗakin kade-kade.
x-e-e2-05.s.s2.r.b: Duk gidan sinima da ɗakin kade-kade suna da layukan kujeru. Waɗannan kalmomi ba su bambanta su ba.
x-e-e2-05.s.s2.r.c: Screen (allon nuna hoto) kalma ce da ta fi muhimmanci a gidan sinima fiye da ɗakin kade-kade. Zai iya zama alamar da ta raba wuraren biyun.
x-e-e2-05.s.s2.r.d: Ana iya jin an ce a yi shiru a wuraren biyun.
x-e-e2-05.s.s2.explain: Kalmomin da suka dace da wurare biyun (layukan kujeru, yin shiru) ba sa bambanta wuraren. Popcorn da screen sun fi zama alamu na gidan sinima. Amma yana iya yi wuya a tabbatar gaba ɗaya da layi guda kawai.

x-e-e2-07.topic: Kalmomin ladabi da kalmomin sada zumunci.

x-e-e2-07.material:
Malami ya ce da safe, “How are you today, Mina?”

Abokinka Jin ya ce, “A Turanci, yin magana cikin ladabi ya fi kyau koyaushe. Za ka iya magana haka da kowa.”
x-e-e2-07.thinking.0: Zaɓi amsa bisa wanda ake magana da shi.
x-e-e2-07.thinking.1: Nemo yanayin da iƙirari bai aiki ba (misalan da ke karyata shi).
x-e-e2-07.prereq.0: Gaisuwa na asali kamar How are you? da I’m fine.
x-e-e2-07.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk amsoshin da suka dace da tambayar malamin.
x-e-e2-07.s.s1.hint.0: Bincika dabam ko amsar ta dace da tambayar da ko ta dace da malami.

x-e-e2-07.s.s1.r.a: Wannan salon magana ne na sakewa sosai da ake amfani da shi tsakanin abokai. Bai dace da malami ba.
x-e-e2-07.s.s1.r.b: An amsa cikin ladabi da kalmomin godiya da “And you?”
x-e-e2-07.s.s1.r.c: An amsa tambayar, amma muryar tana kama da sanyin jiki, saboda haka bai dace da gaisuwar malami ba.
x-e-e2-07.s.s1.r.d: Salon magana na sakewa ne, amma akwai godiya da “And you?”, saboda haka amsa ce da ta dace da malami ma.
x-e-e2-07.s.s1.explain: b da d sun amsa gaisuwar sannan sun tambayi ɗayan mutum, saboda haka sun dace da malami. a ya yi sakewa sosai, c kuma yana jin rashin kunya.
x-e-e2-07.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta misali guda na yanayin da kalmomin Jin “yin magana cikin ladabi ya fi kyau koyaushe” ba gaskiya ba ne. (Turanci ko Korean duk sun dace.)
x-e-e2-07.s.s2.hint.0: Ka yi tunani game da mutum ko yanayi guda inda amfani da kalmomin ladabi zai ji kamar ba na halitta ba.
x-e-e2-07.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta yadda zai ji a yi amfani da kalmomin ladabi da wannan mutumin.

x-e-e2-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Akwai aƙalla misali guda da ke karya da'awar 'koyaushe'?
x-e-e2-07.s.s2.model.0: Faɗin “Zan yi matuƙar farin ciki in yi” ga aboki na kusa yana da tsauri da ban mamaki.
x-e-e2-07.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ya ba da misalin yadda ake magana da aboki.
x-e-e2-07.s.s2.model.3: Baƙon abu ne a yi amfani da kalmomin girmamawa ga ɗan kwikwiyo.

Alamar ƙofar wurin shakatawa (an rubuta da kalmomi kawai, babu hoto):

Sun Park
Buɗe: 7 na safe - 6 na yamma
Babu kekuna.
Ana iya zuwa da karnuka.

Abokinka Tom ya ce, “Zan je Sun Park da kare na da keke na da ƙarfe 7 na yamma!”

x-e-e2-01.s.s1.hint.0: Raba shirin Tom zuwa sassa huɗu, “kare”, “keke”, “lokaci”, da “wuri”, sannan ka daidaita kowanne da layin alamar.

x-e-e2-01.s.s1.r.c: Kwatanta a.m./p.m. da ke kusa da lambar a layin Buɗe da lokacin Tom. Wannan ɓangaren ma ya saɓa, saboda haka bai dace ba.

Amma alamar ta ce ba a yarda da kekuna ba kuma ƙofar tana rufewa da ƙarfe 6 na yamma, alhali Tom ya ce zai kawo keke kuma ya je da ƙarfe 7 na yamma; saboda haka waɗannan sassan biyu ba su dace ba.

x-e-e2-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Amsa mai kyau da ta ma ba da shawarar wani lokaci.

x-e-e2-03.thinking.0: Sake yanke hukunci a kowane lokaci da sabon alama ya bayyana.

x-e-e2-03.thinking.2: Ka ƙirƙiri layi da zai zama alama da kanka.

x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Zaɓi hasashe guda mai yiwuwa bisa ga alamun da aka gani zuwa yanzu. (Akwai yiwuwar amsoshi biyu.)
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Zaɓi hasashe guda mai yiwuwa bisa ga alamun da aka gani zuwa yanzu. (Akwai yiwuwar amsoshi biyu.)
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Daga layi guda, Max na iya zama kare ko yaro. Babu isasshen alama da zai tabbatar da ɗaya daga cikinsu.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ana iya faɗin ‘Good boy’ ga kare ko yaro. Layi guda kaɗai bai isa a bambanta su ba, amma hasashen kare yana da ma’ana.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ana kuma amfani da waɗannan kalmomi ga yara. Layi guda kaɗai bai bambanta su da kare ba.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ba kasafai ake cewa “Good boy” ga babban mutum ba. Ana faɗa wa ƙaramin yaro ko dabba.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Layi na biyu: “Sit! Take the ball, Max! Run!”
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Saboda “Sit!” da wasa da ƙwallo, kare ya fi kama da amsar da ta dace. Yiwuwar cewa yaro ne ba ta ɓace gaba ɗaya ba.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Yaro ma zai iya kama ƙwallo yayin wasa. Yiwuwar tana nan, amma idan aka haɗa da “Sit!”, kare ya fi zama na halitta.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ba kasafai ake ce wa babban mutum ya yi “Sit!” ko ya kama ƙwallo ba.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: “Sit!” da jefa ƙwallo wasanni ne da mutane sukan yi da karnuka.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Layi na uku: Max ya yi magana. “Thank you, Dad! I like this game.”
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Bayan karanta har zuwa wannan layi, wa Max ya fi yiwuwa ya zama?
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Max, wanda yake magana, ya gode wa Dad; saboda haka yaro ne. Za a iya fahimtar wasan “Sit!” na baya a matsayin wasan da ake yi da yaro.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kare ba zai iya cewa “Thank you, Dad!” ba. Wannan layin bai dace da hasashen baya ba.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Babu alamar cewa Max, wanda yake magana da Dad, babban mutum ne. Idan aka yi la’akari da “Good boy” da yanayin wasa, yaro ya fi zama amsar da ta dace fiye da babban mutum.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Yana magana da Dad kuma ya ce yana son wasan, saboda haka an kuma bayyana yanayin wasan na baya.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.reflect: Ko da da farko ka yi hasashen kare, yana da ma’ana ka canza tunaninka bisa sabon alama (Max yana magana). Hasashen da aka kafa daga layi guda kawai na iya canzawa idan sabon alama ya bayyana.
x-e-e2-03.s.s2.prompt: A cikin sabuwar tattaunawa, kana son a gane a sarari cewa Max “kare” ne. Rubuta layi guda na Turanci da ya haɗa da Max.
x-e-e2-03.s.s2.hint.0: Ka yi tunani game da abubuwan da ake yi da kare ko sautukan da kare yake yi.
x-e-e2-03.s.s2.hint.1: Haɗa sunan Max da alamar a cikin jimla guda.
x-e-e2-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wace kalma a layin da na rubuta take nuna cewa kare ne?
x-e-e2-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Za a iya amfani da wannan kalmar ga yaro ma?
x-e-e2-03.s.s2.modelNote.1: Bone alama ce da ke nuna kare.

x-e-e2-06.thinking.1: Bambance furucin ladabi da furucin sada zumunci.
x-e-e2-06.thinking.2: Bayyana ma’ana ɗaya ta hanyoyi biyu.

x-e-e2-06.s.s1.prompt: Ka roƙi malaminka cikin ladabi ya ba ka aron biro. (Jimlar Turanci guda ɗaya)
x-e-e2-06.s.s1.hint.0: Ka yi tunani game da furuci kamar “Could I ~?” da ake amfani da shi wajen yin buƙata.

x-e-e2-06.s.s1.modelNote.1: May I furuci ne na ladabi.

x-e-e2-06.s.s2.hint.1: Saka gajeriyar gaisuwa ko furucin buƙata da abokai suke amfani da shi cikin sauƙi.

x-e-e2-08.goal: A cikin jimloli 5, nemo wadda ta saɓa wa bayanin da ke gabanta da bayanta, sannan ka sake rubuta ta a matsayin jimlar da ta dace da labarin.
x-e-e2-08.material: A ƙasa akwai ɗan gajeren rubutu game da karen gida Coco. Wata jimla ba ta dace da sauran jimlolin rubutun ba.
x-e-e2-08.thinking.0: Kwatanta jimloli da juna domin gano saɓani
x-e-e2-08.thinking.1: Bi ɓangaren da yake da ƙarin shaida

x-e-e2-08.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi jimlar da ba ta dace da sauran jimlolin rubutun ba.
x-e-e2-08.s.s1.hint.0: Tattara layukan da ke bayyana kamannin Coco dabam, sannan ka kwatanta su.

x-e-e2-09.topic: Jimlar da ba ta dace ba
x-e-e2-09.title: Ƙirƙiri jimlar da ba ta dace da rubutun 'ya'yan itace' ba, sannan ka ba aboki a matsayin wasan warwarewa
x-e-e2-09.goal: Fahimci cewa jimlar da ba ta dace ba tana dogara da jigon rubutu, sannan ka ƙirƙiri jigo ɗaya da jimla ɗaya da ba ta dace da shi ba.
x-e-e2-09.material:
Za ka ƙirƙiri wasan 'nemo wanda ya bambanta' domin ba aboki. Da farko, mu duba misali.

Ina son apples. Ina son bananas. Inabi yana da zaƙi. ?
x-e-e2-09.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri jimlar da ba ta dace ba
x-e-e2-09.thinking.2: Bayyana amsar wasan da ka ƙirƙira
x-e-e2-09.prereq.0: Jimloli masu sauƙi kamar I like ~. da ~ is/are ...
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.prompt: Wace ce ba ta dace a matsayin jimla ta huɗu ba? (Jigo: 'ya'yan itace)
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.hint.0: Faɗi jigon da ya haɗa jimloli ukun farko da kalma guda.
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.hint.1: Duba ko akwai jimlar da ba ta cikin wannan jigo.
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.r.a: Peach 'ya'yan itace ne, saboda haka ya dace da jigon.
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.r.b: Orange ma 'ya'yan itace ne, saboda haka ya dace.
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.r.c: Carrot ba 'ya'yan itace ba ne. Idan aka ɗauki jigon a matsayin 'ya'yan itace', bai dace ba.
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.explain: Jimloli ukun farko duk game da 'ya'yan itace ne (apples, bananas, grapes). Carrot kayan lambu ne, saboda haka bai dace da jigon ba. Idan aka faɗaɗa jigon zuwa 'abinci', carrot ma zai iya dacewa. Ko ya dace ya danganta da yadda ka ƙayyade jigon.
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri wasa domin ba aboki. (1) Jimlolin Turanci uku da suka dace da jigo ɗaya, (2) jimla guda da ba ta dace ba (ta huɗu), (3) rubuta amsar a ƙarshe, kamar “Wadda ta bambanta: 4.”
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi jigo guda (dabbobi, makaranta, abinci, da sauransu), sannan ka fara rubuta jimloli uku game da jigon.
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta jimla ta huɗu game da wani jigo dabam, sannan ka ƙara 'Wadda ta bambanta: 4.'
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Jigon jimloli ukun farko guda ɗaya ne a sarari?
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Jimla ta huɗu tana kan wani jigo dabam amma tana da irin tsarin jimla ɗaya?
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Lokacin da abokinka ke warwarewa, wace alama zai yi amfani da ita domin gano amsar?
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.modelNote.0: An gauraya maganar abinci da labarin cat.
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.modelNote.1: An gauraya jimlar tiger da labarin makaranta.

x-e-e2-10.title: Ƙirƙiri tambaya guda da za ta gano bayanin da ya ɓace a saƙon rubutu
x-e-e2-10.goal: Nemo bayanin da ba ya cikin saƙon, zaɓi tambaya mafi amfani guda ɗaya, sannan ka ƙirƙiri tambayarka a sabon yanayi.
x-e-e2-10.material:
Abokinka Sora ya aiko da saƙo.

“Mu yi wasa gobe! Kawo ƙwallo.”

Kana son zuwa, amma akwai wasu abubuwa da ba za ka iya gane wa ba.
x-e-e2-10.thinking.2: Samo bayanin da kake buƙata da tambaya guda
x-e-e2-10.prereq.0: Kalmomin tambaya kamar When, Where, What time
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi tambaya guda mafi amfani da za a yi wa Sora.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.hint.0: Raba saƙon zuwa ginshiƙai biyu: abin da ya riga ya gaya maka da abin da har yanzu ba ka sani ba.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin abin da dole ne ka sani domin ku haɗu.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.r.a: Wannan tambayar tana neman bayanai biyu lokaci guda: wurin da lokaci, dukkansu wajibi ne domin haɗuwa.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.r.b: Saƙon ya riga ya ce a kawo ƙwallo. Zai yi kyau a san irin ƙwallon, amma wannan ba ya ba da sauran bayanin da ake buƙata.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.r.c: Za ka iya sanin wurin, amma har yanzu ba ka san lokacin ba. An warware abu guda kawai.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.r.d: Ko Sora yana son ƙwallo ba bayani ba ne da ake buƙata domin haɗuwa.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.explain: Saƙon yana da 'gobe' da 'kawo ƙwallo' kawai; wurin da lokaci sun ɓace. Tambayar da ke neman waɗannan bayanai biyu lokaci guda ita ce mafi amfani. Tambayar wurin kaɗai tana barin lokacin ba a sani ba, tambayoyi game da irin ƙwallo ko abin da Sora ke so kuma ba su da muhimmanci wajen haɗuwa.
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.prompt: Wannan sabon yanayi ne. Baba ya ce: “Za mu yi tafiya ranar Asabar.” Rubuta tambayar Turanci guda don gano muhimmin bayanin da ya ɓace. (Yi amfani da alamar tambaya guda ɗaya kawai.)
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.hint.0: Ware abin da ka sani daga kalmomin Baba (Asabar, tafiya) da abin da ba ka sani ba.
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi ɗaya daga cikin abubuwan da ba ka sani ba, sannan ka yi tambaya da ta fara da Where ko What time.
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Tambayata tana neman bayanin da ba ya cikin kalmomin Baba?
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Amsar tambayar za ta taimaka wajen shirin tafiyar?
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.modelNote.1: Tambayar lokaci ma tana da kyau.
